row.notes: Value-map reserve point in Gdb_Load_GameDatabase: after the map is initialised (0x1445a04dd..0x1445a0535) and before the first Gdb_HashMap_Insert. Here rcx = reserve target = max(file record count, map.num_elements); [rsp+0x88] = file record count, the insert loop bound (0x1445a0be7, 0x1445a0c49), separate from rcx; r14 = file buffer (u32 count at [r14]); r12 = db; r15 = &db->map.mask. The game then takes the smallest power of two N>=8 with N*80/100 >= rcx and calls Gdb_HashMap_Rehash(&db->map, N) at 0x1445a0aa3 when N > mask+1. Raising rcx here is reserve(rcx): rcx feeds only the bucket count (clobbered by lea rcx at 0x1445a0a98). Planned core sizing hook (W7-SIZING.md)

verify.notes: V1343 Re-derived from disassembly. rax=&db->map.num_elements (lea r12+0xd0, 0x1445a09db), ecx=u32 [r14] with r14=[0x146cc4268] the file buffer (0x1445a09f5), [rsp+0x88]=count, cmova -> rcx=max(count,num_elements). num_elements is 0 here: the init zeroes it (0x1445a0513) and nothing between 0x1445a053e and the site reaches Gdb_HashMap_Insert or Gdb_HashMap_Rehash (their only rel32 callers are 0x1445a0c3b,0x1445a0e17 and 0x1445a0aa3,0x1445a1325; no absolute refs), so rcx = file count (installed gamedatabases.2025.bin: 742,857, parsed to EOF). rcx is read only by cmp rdx,rcx (0x1445a0a7f) in the inlined robin_hood reserve loop and is dead after it: lea rcx (0x1445a0a98) on the rehash path, mov ecx,0xab (0x1445a0ae0) on the skip path, no read in between; flags are dead (cmp at 0x1445a0a33 sets them first). Window: mov eax,8 is exactly 5 bytes and not ip-relative, so safetyhook e9_hook relocates only it; the 14-byte ff fallback would take mov eax,8 plus movabs r9 (to 0x1445a0a20), also not ip-relative. The only branch into 0x1445a09f0..0x1445a0a30 is jb 0x1445a0a30. r12=db (0x1445a0366), r15=db+0xd8 (0x1445a04f7) and r14 are not rewritten before the site. Raising rcx changes only the bucket count N
